reviewer_scope: Independent source and focused-guard review; no source authorship.

verdict_A_live_spec.finding: The recovered native run 37288331617 establishes that the old acceptance oracle evaluated the opening reply while the follow-up was still streaming, before any follow-up run or POST was recorded. That supports the reported oracle cause. It predates this repair and does not verify the repaired flow.
verdict_A_live_spec.required_remaining_evidence: A fresh public no-login native run must prove opening HTTP 200 and grounded terminal content, a separate same-conversation HTTP 200 and grounded terminal reply, then post-reload follow-up; retain actual wire and terminal evidence.

verdict_B_source_quality.finding: The repair checkpoints run, reply, and tool-event counts immediately before each send. Until a post-boundary run exists, the prior completed run cannot turn its old answer into terminal_wrong_answer. A new run's failure remains terminal, and its successful answer must add a reply beyond the checkpoint and satisfy the grounding terms. Follow-up diagnostics slice tool events from the same boundary. The new oracle regression is included in CI.
verdict_B_source_quality.reachability_caveat: An adversarial direct classifier call with priorRunCount=1 and errorNotice=true returns terminal_error before a new run appears. This is a synthetic stale-alert input for the reported acceptance path: the opening gate requires !answered.errorNotice, the follow-up stays in the same pane, and submitQuestion does not change alert state. Inspected alert sources are conversation loadError and voice input error/warning; the reproduced successful opening does not create either, and the acceptance does not use voice input. Keep immediate error detection. No evidence found that this caveat reaches the recovered pending-turn failure.
verdict_B_source_quality.guard_quality: The added behavioral case places a completed opening run and reply before the boundary, checks that old history and an in-progress new stream stay in_progress, then checks distinct grounded success and wrong-answer results after a new completed run. A separate case confirms a new follow-up failure remains terminal. These are useful behavioral assertions at the classifier seam. The commit receipt reports RED-before-fix and return-expected/old-run mutations; those mutation experiments were not independently repeated in this review.
verdict_B_source_quality.ci: Confirmed .github/workflows/ci.yml runs guest-chat-completion-oracle.test.mjs, guest-chat-transport-observer.test.mjs, and guest-chat-store-sequence.test.mjs.

adversarial_classifier.interpretation: The second case demonstrates the caveat above; concrete acceptance precondition and UI-source tracing did not establish it as reachable after a passing opening answer.
